description: This PHP class parses sheet view configurations from an XLSX file, extracting display options such as zoom, view layout, gridlines, headers, pane configuration, and selection. It modifies the worksheet object accordingly to represent the view settings defined in the XML.

classes.name: SheetViews
classes.description: Handles the parsing and application of sheet view settings from the XML in an XLSX file to a Worksheet object, including view options, zoom, gridlines, headers, pane splits, and cell selection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the instance with the XML node representing the sheet view and the worksheet to modify.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Executes the parsing and applies various view settings to the worksheet based on the XML attributes.

methods.name: zoomScale
methods.description: Reads zoom scale attributes from XML and applies them to the worksheet's sheet view.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Sets the view type (e.g., page layout, normal) for the worksheet.

methods.name: topLeft
methods.description: Sets the top-left cell in the view.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Configures whether row and column headers are shown.

methods.name: direction
methods.description: Sets the text direction (left-to-right or right-to-left).

methods.name: pane
methods.description: Configures frozen panes based on XML attributes.

methods.name: selection
methods.description: Sets which cells are selected based on XML data.
